'''James Augustine''' (born [[February 27]] [[1984]] in [[Mokena, Illinois]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] [[player (game)|player]].  Augustine attended [[Lincoln-Way Central High School]] in [[New Lenox, IL]] where he graduated in 2002.  While at Lincoln-Way, Augustine played both football and basketball.  Augustine played for the [[University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign|University of Illinois]] men's basketball team from the 2002-03 to 2005-06 seasons.  Playing both the [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[center (basketball)|center]] positions, his career with the Illini included many team records, a trip to the national championship game, and several awards.  He is currently projected to be selected late in the first round or early in the second round of the [[NBA Draft]].

==Records and Awards==
Augustine holds the school record for career [[rebound (basketball)|rebound]]s.  He became the first [[Illinois Fighting Illini|Fighting Illini]] player and the 12th player in [[Big Ten Conference]] history to accumulate 1000 points and 1000 rebounds.  This feat was last accomplished by [[Alan Henderson]], who played for [[Indiana University Bloomington|Indiana University]] from [[1992]] to [[1995]].  Augustine shares the award for career victories with [[Dee Brown (Illini)|Dee Brown]], with 114 wins.

Augustine was also named Most Outstanding Player in the 2005 [[Big Ten Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|Big Ten Tournament]].
